newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ net global investment NZ$73.3 bln at Mar 96.
newsitem.headline: NZ net global investment NZ$73.3 bln at Mar 96.

text.p: New Zealand's net international investment position was a NZ$73.3 billion deficit at March 31, 1996, Statistics New Zealand said on Thursday.
This was a $1.8 billion deterioration from a deficit of $71.5 billion at March 31, 1995.
"An increase in international assets was more than offset by a rise in international liabilities," SNZ said.
The level of investment abroad by New Zealand residents was $28.4 billion at March 1996, a rise of $5.3 billion over March 1995.
The level of foreign investment in New Zealand continued to rise, up $7.1 billion to $101.6 billion at March 31, 1996.
Rising direct investment in New Zealand remains the major influence, SNZ said.

The level of New Zealand's international assets rose by $6.7 billion to $36.7 billion in the year, with a $4.7 billion rise in the level of New Zealand's equity capital assets overseas the major contributor.
The level of New Zealand's international liabilities rose by $8.5 billion to $110 billion in the year. A $5 billion rise in foreign equity investment in New Zealand was the major driver.
